messages:
Ravi (Partnerships): Heads-up: AtlasSI (partner) needs our listing bundle for the marketplace. They want SOC2 + latest vuln scan (CIS/nessus), firmware attestation statement for TitanEdge, and a short Q&A filled by us. Can we map owners?
Nora (InfoSec): We can provide SOC2 type II (PDF). For vuln output: we should NOT share raw Nessus XML publicly. Proposal: provide CSV summary with CVE, severity, affected component, and remediation status. Keep PoC and exploitation details out.
Pete (Partner Eng): AtlasSI asked whether we can include raw configs for device onboarding. We should avoid that. Instead we can provide sanitized sample configs with placeholders. Also they requested checksums for firmware images and a signed manifest.
Zoe (Compliance): Requirements from marketplace intake: top-level manifest (manifest.json), an artifacts.csv for ingestion, and a single compressed archive (.tar.gz). They accept SHA256 for checksums. Also they require an attestation on letterhead that firmware images are scanned and do not include backdoors. Legal will need to sign.
Nora (InfoSec): Agreed on SHA256 over MD5. I'll run CIS benchmark and export two artifacts: 1) raw scan for SecOps internal only (S3 private), 2) sanitized CSV for partner. I'll redact full pathnames and internal hostnames.
Ravi (Partnerships): TTL for presigned links? AtlasSI requested 5 days. Is that okay or should we stick with 72h?
Pete (Partner Eng): 5 days is OK for partners in different timezones. We'll add an expiry timestamp in the README and rotate if necessary.
Zoe (Compliance): Quick note on attestations: do not use the word "certified" or "endorsed". Use this template: "Redwood confirms the provided artifacts are representative of our current production configuration. No customer-identifiable information is included." Legal sign-off required.
Nora (InfoSec): Scrub rules I'll apply: remove emails, replace hostnames with HOST_<N>, remove AWS account IDs, drop network ranges. Keep CVE IDs and remediation status. Example rule snippet:
```
# scrub.conf
redact: ["email","hostname","aws_account_id","ip_range"]
preserve: ["cve","severity","component","fix_version"]
replace_with: "<REDACTED>"
```
I'll publish the scrub log (sha256) so we can audit what was removed.
Deploy Bot: artifact-builder job #721 succeeded. generated: evidence-1748012345.tar.gz, manifest.json, artifacts.csv :white_check_mark:
Pete (Partner Eng): For firmware: we'll provide checksums and a separate small attestation PDF. Per TitanEdge team, we should NOT include full firmware binaries in the initial bundle. We'll provide checksums and a secure-download link via partner portal if they need the blob.
Zoe (Compliance): Marketplace ingestion wants a one-line summary for each artifact describing sensitivity (public/internal/restricted). Add that column to artifacts.csv.
Ravi (Partnerships): Action owners: Nora to run scans & produce sanitized CSV (owner), Pete to build manifest + signed manifest (owner), Zoe to draft attestation & sensitivity labels (owner), Legal to review wording (owner). Target: delivery by 2024-09-05 18:00 PDT so AtlasSI can complete listing by month-end.
Nora (InfoSec): I'll post the sanitized CSV and the scrub audit sha256 here after the run tomorrow morning.
Pete (Partner Eng): I'll GPG-sign manifest.json and include pubkey fingerprint in README. Example manifest fragment (for ingestion):
```
{
  "archive": "evidence-1748012345.tar.gz",
  "sha256": "<sha256-hash>",
  "signed_by": "0xA1B2C3D4E5F6"
}
```
Zoe (Compliance): I'll add the sensitivity column to artifacts.csv and draft the attestation PDF. Once Legal approves, I'll attach it to the bundle.
Ravi (Partnerships): Also AtlasSI wants co-announcement language for the marketplace tile; will loop Legal for copy. Avoid implying Redwood audited AtlasSI — keep it to integration/compliance artifacts provided.
Pete (Partner Eng): One more thing: AtlasSI asked if we can timestamp-stamp manifest with ISO8601. I'll include that so they can correlate versions.
Zoe (Compliance): Ok reconvene Thursday 10:30am PT to verify bundle and go/no-go for announcement copy. If artifacts are ready by Wed EOD we should be fine. Thanks all. :rocket:
